不用规划容量，存多少付多少，数据持久性 11 个 9；越放越冷的数据还能自动转到: You don't need to plan capacity, you pay for what you store, and durability is 11 nines; data that gets colder over time can move automatically to cheaper storage classes
多台机器要读写同一批文件时，不用自己搭 NFS 服务器，容量随用随长: When several machines need to read and write the same files, you don't have to run your own NFS server, and capacity grows as you use it
要低延迟、像本地硬盘一样的块存储时用它，快照按增量备份: Use it when you need low-latency block storage that works like a local disk; snapshots are incremental backups
登录这件事不用自己写：密码存储、MFA、找回密码、社交登录都是现成的，还能直接给: You don't have to build sign-in yourself: password storage, MFA, password recovery and social sign-in are ready to use, and API Gateway and ALB can use it directly for authentication
智能体上生产要的运行隔离、会话记忆、工具网关、身份认证都托管好了，不用自己搭一套: The runtime isolation, session memory, tool gateway and identity that agents need in production are all managed, so you don't have to build them yourself
要完全掌控操作系统、装特殊软件、跑老应用时用它，机型最全: Use it when you need full control of the operating system, special software or legacy apps; it has the widest range of instance types
代码不多、按事件触发的活交给它：不用管服务器和扩容，没请求就不花钱: Give it small, event-triggered jobs: no servers or scaling to manage, and no requests means no cost
把资源放进自己的私有网络，子网和安全组决定谁能访问，数据库不用暴露在公网上: Put resources in your own private network, where subnets and security groups decide who can reach them, so databases don't have to be exposed to the internet
多台后端前面放一个统一入口：自动分流量、绕开坏掉的实例，天生跨 AZ: One entry point in front of multiple backends: it spreads traffic automatically, routes around failed instances, and spans AZs by design
域名解析和健康检查一起做：一边挂了自动切到另一边: DNS resolution and health checks together: if one side goes down, traffic switches to the other automatically
镜像就放在部署的地方旁边：和 ECS、EKS 权限打通，推送时顺手扫漏洞: Images sit right next to where they're deployed: permissions work directly with ECS and EKS, and images are scanned for vulnerabilities when you push them
想跑容器又不想学 Kubernetes 时选它，配 Fargate 连机器都不用: Choose it when you want to run containers without learning Kubernetes; with Fargate you don't even manage machines
团队已经在用 Kubernetes，要沿用 Helm 和社区工具时选它: Choose it when your team already uses Kubernetes and wants to keep using Helm and community tools
不用自己搭网关：鉴权、限流、缓存、版本管理开箱就有，后面直接接 Lambda: No need to build your own gateway: authorization, throttling, caching and version management work out of the box, with Lambda connected right behind it
访问方式固定、并发特别高时用它：没有数据库服务器要管，读写延迟稳定在毫秒级: Use it when access patterns are fixed and concurrency is very high: there are no database servers to manage, and read and write latency stays steady at the millisecond level
前后两段处理速度不一样时放一个队列：峰值先排队，后端按自己的节奏取，失败的还能重: Put a queue between two stages that process at different speeds: peaks wait in the queue, the backend pulls at its own pace, and failed messages can be retried
发事件的和处理事件的互不认识：多加一个处理方不用改发送方，还能按时间表触发: Event senders and event handlers don't need to know each other: adding a handler doesn't require changing the sender, and it can also trigger on a schedule
多步骤的流程不用自己写状态机：每一步的重试、超时、失败回滚都能配，执行到哪一步看: No need to write your own state machine for multi-step processes: retries, timeouts and rollback on failure can be configured for each step, and you can see which step a run has reached
要关系库又不想自己运维时用它：备份、补丁、多 AZ 故障切换都托管，引擎选择最多: Use it when you need a relational database but don't want to run it yourself: backups, patching and Multi-AZ failover are managed, and it offers the widest choice of engines
要更高性能和可用性的 MySQL、PostgreSQL 时选它：存储自动跨 3: Choose it when you need MySQL or PostgreSQL with higher performance and availability: storage spans 3 AZs automatically, and read replicas have low lag
同样的数据被反复读时放一层内存缓存：亚毫秒返回，数据库压力小很多: When the same data is read over and over, add an in-memory cache layer: sub-millisecond responses and much less load on the database
源库不用改代码：先全量复制，再持续抓变更（CDC），迁移割接停机短；平时也能把改: No code changes on the source database: it does a full load first, then keeps capturing changes (CDC), so migration cutover downtime is short; day to day it can also sync changes in real time to search, a data lake or a data warehouse
数据一条条持续进来、要实时处理时用它：扛得住突发流量，多个消费者能同时读: Use it when records keep streaming in and must be processed in real time: it handles traffic bursts, and multiple consumers can read at the same time
清洗数据、转格式、建数据目录不用自己搭集群，按运行时间付费: Clean data, convert formats and build a data catalog without running your own cluster, and pay for run time
偶尔查一查 S3 里的数据时最省事：不用建库、不用管服务器，按扫描的数据量付费: The easiest way to query data in S3 now and then: no database to set up, no servers to manage, and you pay for the data scanned
数据量大、报表和复杂 SQL 多时用它：列式存储加大规模并行，几十亿行也查得动: Use it for large data volumes with lots of reports and complex SQL: columnar storage plus massively parallel processing can query billions of rows
要全文搜索、模糊匹配、日志实时检索时用它，这些用关系库做又慢又压库: Use it for full-text search, fuzzy matching and real-time log search, which are slow on a relational database and put load on it
不用装代理，开了就分析 CloudTrail、VPC 流日志和 DNS 日志，发: No agents to install: once it's on, it analyzes CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs and DNS logs to find anomalies such as crypto mining and leaked credentials
自动发现 EC2、容器镜像和 Lambda 里的漏洞，新 CVE 出来不用等人去: Finds vulnerabilities in EC2, container images and Lambda automatically, so when a new CVE comes out, you don't have to wait for someone to run a scan
密钥不用自己保管：存数据的服务都能直接用它加密，谁用了密钥 CloudTrail: You don't have to keep keys yourself: services that store data can use it directly for encryption, and CloudTrail records who used each key
用户分布广、静态内容多时放在最前面：就近返回，源站压力小，还能在边缘挡攻击: Put it at the very front when users are spread out and there's a lot of static content: responses come from nearby, the origin carries less load, and attacks can be blocked at the edge
在入口按规则拦 SQL 注入、XSS、恶意爬虫和刷接口，不用改应用代码: Blocks SQL injection, XSS, malicious bots and API abuse with rules at the entry point, without changing application code
扛大流量 DDoS：有专家团队 7×24 小时响应，攻击期间多出来的扩容费用能申: Withstands large DDoS attacks: an expert team responds around the clock, and you can request credits for the extra scaling costs incurred during an attack
要自己训练、微调或部署模型时用它：训练、调参、上线、监控在一个平台里: Use it when you need to train, fine-tune or deploy models yourself: training, tuning, deployment and monitoring in one platform
想直接用现成的大模型时选它：一个 API 调多家模型，不用管 GPU，按 tok: Choose it when you want to use ready-made large models directly: one API for models from many providers, no GPUs to manage, and you pay per token
指标、日志、告警都在这里，出问题第一时间知道: Metrics, logs and alarms are all here, so you know the moment something goes wrong
记录谁在什么时候调了哪个 API，出事能追溯: Records who called which API and when, so you can trace what happened after an incident
记录资源配置怎么变的，自动检查合不合规: Records how resource configurations change and checks compliance automatically
RDS、Aurora 自己没法把数据推给 OpenSearch，DMS 不用改应: RDS and Aurora can't push data to OpenSearch on their own; DMS keeps syncing database changes over without any application code changes
直接读数据库的变更日志，不用在业务代码里埋点，也不用定时全表扫描压源库: It reads the database's change log directly, so you don't need hooks in business code or scheduled full-table scans that load the source database
站内搜索要模糊匹配、按相关度排序，用 SQL 的 LIKE 做又慢又压库: Site search needs fuzzy matching and relevance ranking, and doing that with SQL LIKE is slow and loads the database
开发、测试环境晚上和周末没人用，EC2 停下来就不收计算费（EBS 盘照收）: Development and test environments sit unused at night and on weekends, and a stopped EC2 instance isn't charged for compute (EBS volumes are still charged)
安全组挂在 EC2 上，对 0.0.0.0/0 开着 22、3389 端口，是最: Security groups are attached to EC2, and ports 22 and 3389 left open to 0.0.0.0/0 are the most common way attackers get in

多个消费者能同时读同一条流；增强扇出给每个消费者独享的读取吞吐: Multiple consumers can read the same stream at the same time; enhanced fan-out gives each consumer its own dedicated read throughput
